integrity: Analytical deduction from a cited prior first-order shape theorem, supplemented by exact rational arithmetic and a standalone reproduction script; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed symmetric four-class speed vector, fixed r, equal initial class sizes. Critical final-exchange type probabilities and rates of convergence not established. The first-order variational formula is from prior literature; a related old LPP text was not fully accessible.
title: A sharp three-cut coexistence threshold for four-speed stochastic sorting
